$comment: Machine config, not brand. Every model call routes through scripts/routing.py, so this is the ONLY file that names a model. `model` is the full id (pricing, calibrate); `alias` is what Workflow agent() takes. Override to match your plan.

result.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: caught 3/5 then 2/5 seeded defects across two runs; not reliable enough
result.claude-sonnet-5: caught 5/5 seeded defects unanimously, each citing the correct gate; flagged 2/2 clean controls on gate 8

calibration.note: NOT pinned. Sonnet catches every seeded defect, but both clean controls also fail gate 8 (whitespace/void) 3-0. Investigation showed the controls are genuinely defective: the bar-card example floats in a large frame. The critics are right, so the fixture is wrong, not the tier. Re-run after the example card gets a design pass. Until then `critic` stays on Sonnet as a reasoned default rather than a measurement.

pricing.$comment: USD per million tokens. Used only by --report-cost. Update when pricing changes.
